key_findings: No-helper (e2) frame residual: GVN (MIR pass 005-015) strips StorageLive/Dead of the CompleteEvent emit_cpi temps authority_info/inner_data/Chain iterator, because the macro's own moves make GVN reuse those SSA locals; not source-controllable at handler level

rustc 1.79 MIR inliner applies its cost threshold even to #[inline(always)]; emit_cpi helpers are never MIR-inlined, so the original's call-scoped markers come from the LLVM inliner (pre-simplified callee)

Any LLVM-inlined helper holding the CompleteEvent emit_cpi gives a fully correct frame; the TradeEvent emit_cpi can also live in that helper without changing the frame; emit!(ev) in the helper adds a 24 B slot (+0x18 shift)

Complete-if sense: original jeq+1/ja arises only when the then-block is not the next IR block at ISel; inlined helper blocks are spliced contiguously, so a helper whose entry is the cond is always then-next
Niche Result<()> helper keeps an Err tag test on the CPI Err path (Error::from external, unknown range); PR #2264 fixed it with a tagged Result
Prepare rewrap needs Err edge straight to a shared error phi and an Ok-only block (llc oracle on a9 IR)
is_mayhem select regresses when no ? exit follows the TradeEvent literal in the handler: the post_fee_amount ? exit's shareholders drop chain becomes unshared and merges next to the cond
